violation_type.title: Multiple Operations-Separate director for each (26 TAC §746.1005(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: The director is listed as director of 2 day care locations. There was not a designated director for another location. This was corrected during inspection when paperwork was completed and turned in for director designee.
